summary: This bill requires federal agencies to submit annual reports to the Office of Management and Budget detailing taxpayer-funded projects that are either more than five years behind schedule or at least $1 billion over budget, including explanations for delays and cost increases.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to increase transparency and oversight of taxpayer-funded projects that are over budget or behind schedule. While it doesn't directly alter spending levels, by identifying and reporting on inefficient projects, it implicitly seeks to reduce wasteful spending in the long term. The focus on identifying 'boondoggles' suggests a goal of fiscal responsibility.
